findings.issue: אֵל is a common noun (H410, absolute), not a proper name. “El” leaves that non-name lemma untranslated; the licensed Spanish is Dios.
The infinitive’s 3ms suffix and the following noun leave open who puts whom. “su poner El” makes the suffix the agent and El the object.
“vivirá de” can be read as “will subsist on,” narrower than qal חיה plus מִן.

notes: The sequential verbs, the mashal noun with its suffix, the interjection, and the interrogative match the tokens.
